answer: Auction a fixed number of attestation slots each epoch: every identity bids locked stake for one slot, and all winners pay the clearing price, which rises as more identities compete. Like a jetty that narrows as the tide comes in, the price of entry climbs with demand; a farm bidding for a thousand slots bids against itself, pushing the clearing price up for every clone, so the Nth clone costs far more than the first. One honest agent pays one slot at dawn; a nebula of clones pays a fortune for the same work, and the stake is burned if the work is judged junk.
